graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary text, headings, nav links, icon strokes — the typographic anchor of every surface

canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page background, card elevation, icon fills — the brightest surface in the system

ash.$description: Ash — Primary card and section background, nav pill container — the dominant warm-gray surface

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle background tone for nested surfaces and secondary containers

ivory.$description: Ivory — Warm accent background wash for featured blocks — the paper-stock feel

steel.$description: Steel — Secondary body text, long-form paragraph copy

slate.$description: Slate — Muted helper text, tertiary nav items, inactive controls

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline dividers, nav background fills

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Orange text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

brass.$description: Brass — Secondary accent for chart strokes, decorative SVG lines, and tag text — a muted warm counterpoint to Ember

polysans.$description: Headings and display text — custom neo-grotesque used exclusively at weight 400 with -0.02em tracking creates a whisper-weight editorial authority that no bold headline could replicate

inter.$description: Body copy, UI labels, button text, captions, metadata — the workhorse sans for everything that isn't a headline
